Mona: Quick pulse — we need to prioritize the MUX onramp dependencies for the Q3 customer pilot. They want private deployment + HSM and burst capacity. Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security list non-negotiable blockers by EOD? 
Jake: Can you list the top customer flows? that'll help size infra. 
Mona: Top flows: 1) low-latency chat (<=150ms p50), 2) batched embeddings for search, 3) bulk reindex jobs. Customer will require VPC + KMS+HSM. 
Priya: For low-latency chat we can provide a quantized variant as fallback. Need to know expected qps to size KV cache. 
Sam: We have a limited burst slot pool for dedicated right now. If this pilot expects 200qps burst we need a reservation commit. Otherwise we can schedule prewarm windows. 
Li: HSM integration adds ~2 weeks for attestation + KMS IAM mapping. Also need to validate key wrapping for multi-tenant test. 
Nora: Also important: what SLO do we promise for canary vs GA? Canary should accept higher error budget. We need a rollback plan for KV cache corruption. 
Jake: Can eng runtime sketch an API-compatible fallback plan? If quantized model diverges we need automatic reroute to full model. 
Priya: Plan: runtime will add a 'model_family_fallback' flag + prefix cache tagging. Pseudocode: 
```
if latency > 200ms and fallback_enabled:
  route_to: quantized_variant
  tag_cache(prefix='qv:')
```
This keeps KV namespaces separate. 
Li: Security check: ensure HSM key IDs are not leaked to logs. Add a lint to scrub `key_id` fields. 
Mona: Acceptance criteria draft: private deploy + KMS/HSM integration validated in staging; prewarm handles target burst with >=95% p50 SLO; canary traffic shows <3% regression on embedding quality. 
Sam: I'll propose a reservation plan by tomorrow. If product signs a small commit we can reserve slots. 
Jake: dev tasks: (1) add fallback flag (Priya), (2) add canary job and synthetic load (Nora), (3) add metrics for model-switch events (Jake). 
Mona: OK — owners: Priya (runtime), Sam (infra), Li (security), Nora (sre), Jake (eng). Sync 30m tomorrow 10:30 PT? 
Priya: 10:30 works for runtime. 
Nora: yes. 
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: https://meet.redwood.com/rooms/abcdef — invite sent. 
Mona: thanks all. :raised_hands:
